method.solver: OSQP1.1.3 convex QP; SLSQP reference objective retained for parity tests.
method.structure: Same contextual regional layer as first convergence model, but anchor regional score gaps and adjacent-context changes to a training-only v10 pilot instead of zero. Fix domestic shade/vintage/tare scales to pilot values. Foreign-only scores unchanged.
method.equality: Adaptive L1 fusion on domestic complete-score gaps at120 lb. Only matched regional comparisons in training determine fusion support, with reciprocal age/shade-distance weighting within the same region pair. No hard regional tie labels; no lookup-based prediction.

priors.premium_loss_weight: training matched-regional tie/premium count ratio, clipped to[1,4]
priors.note: Prespecified modeling conventions; no numeric conversion of slight preferences. Preserve positive v10 pilot component scales and original local tare equalities.

method.selection: Average overall class-balanced accuracy and matched-regional equality-versus-correct-premium balanced accuracy. Select strength0.1/1/10; ties favor smaller strength. All metrics from inner held-out training folds only.
method.validation: Same evidence and v10 five outer family folds xfive seeds. Reproduce every v10 baseline prediction. Inner3 folds refit offering and pilot; pilot prior strength selected in an additional3 grouped subfolds INSIDE each inner training partition. Fusion support and premium weights use only inner training rows. Outer pilot uses saved v10 training-selected strength; full pilot is v10 all-data fit.
method.limits: Exploratory refinement after prior outer results; repeated adaptive evidence, not fresh prospective validation. Original Q7/Q11 excluded.101 regional parameters fitted plus3 fixed pilot scales;250 auxiliary fusion variables are optimization only.
